definitions.full: H4516. manammim [ מַנְעַמִּים ] noun [masculine] plural delicacies, dainities ; — only suffix בְּמַנְעַמֵּיהֶם וּבַלאֶֿלְחַם Psa 141:4 . II. נעם (perhaps to be assumed as √ of following, Ne Marg. 10 ; Arabic speak in a low, Gentle voice , note, melody ; Syriac rugivit , gentle sound, note ; Late Hebrew נְלִימָה melody ; Ecclus 45:9 נעימה לתת to make music ; compare Hiph`il Ecclesiasticus 47:9b margin).
